full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white photograph of a rough path beside tall grasses. The camera focuses very near, on slender grass stems and seed heads occupying the right half. Sunlight catches their delicate tips, making tiny bright threads against the darker field behind. The path runs from the lower left toward a glowing upper-left distance, but its stones and scattered highlights are soft and uncertain. Far along it, two human silhouettes stand or walk together. They are intentionally out of focus, reduced to dark vertical gestures within the bright haze. Trees frame the distance, their leaves dissolving into soft light and shadow. The near grasses vary from silver-gray to almost black, with crisp individual stalks crossing each other at different angles. The right edge is darker and dense with vegetation. The left side opens into a broad luminous blur. Fine grain and high contrast make the small highlights on grass and ground sparkle without converting the image to pure black and white shapes. There is no clear architectural setting or close facial detail. The composition depends on a reversal of expected attention: the minor grass in front is precise, while the people who might tell a story remain distant and ambiguous. The shallow depth of field makes space feel layered even though much of the background is visually dissolved. Natural backlight fills the upper opening and outlines the fine plants. The mood is quiet, fleeting, and observational, like a moment noticed while walking. The image's distinctive finish comes from film grain, near-focus texture, blurred human forms, and luminous monochrome atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白照片，一条粗糙小路沿高草延伸。相机聚焦极近处右半的细草茎和籽穗。日光照到纤细顶端，使细亮线立于后方较深的区域。小路从左下通向左上发亮的远处，石块和散落亮点却柔软不确定。远处有两个人影站着或同行。它们有意失焦，只是亮雾里的深竖向手势。树框住远处，叶在柔明暗中消融。近草从银灰到近黑变化，清脆独立的茎以不同角度互相交叉。右边更暗且植物密。左侧敞向宽阔发亮的模糊区域。细颗粒和高反差使草与地面的细亮点闪动，却没有把图像变成纯黑白形状。没有明确建筑环境或近人脸。构图依赖通常注意顺序的倒置：前方不起眼的草精确，而可能讲故事的人仍远且不明。浅景深让空间分层，即使背景很多部分在视觉上消解。自然逆光填满上方亮口，描出细植物。气氛安静、转瞬且有观察感，像行走时发现的一刻。胶片颗粒、近焦肌理、模糊人形与明亮单色空气构成其独特质地。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white film photography uses shallow focus and backlight to make fine nearby texture sharp against a dissolved bright distance. Silver-gray stems, threads, droplets, or comparable details catch small highlights, while farther shapes soften to silhouettes. A dark vegetated edge can balance a pale open route. Grain remains apparent in both midtones and shadow, and high contrast gives luminous specks a slight shimmer. Spatial depth comes from deliberate focus separation rather than a fully sharp scene. The frame feels found rather than staged, with small foreground matter receiving close attention and background activity left suggestive. The effect is quiet, fleeting, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白胶片摄影以浅景深和逆光让近处细肌理在消融的亮远方前变清楚。银灰色茎、线、水珠或类似细节接住小高光，更远形体则软化成剪影。深植被边缘可平衡浅色开放路径。中间调与阴影中颗粒依然明显，高反差让明亮小点微微闪烁。空间纵深来自有意的焦点分离，而非全景皆清晰。画面像被发现而非摆拍，微小前景物受到近观，背景活动仅作暗示。效果安静、转瞬且可触。
theme_en: Sunlit grasses sharp beside a path where two distant people blur
theme_zh: 受日光照亮的草在小路旁清晰，两名远处的人影模糊
name: Ilford HP5+ 400
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
